fields.description: ELO 2 is DAMAC’s apartment development within the parkland setting of DAMAC Hills 2. One- and two-bedroom homes are paired with a pool, fitness spaces and family recreation, with further leisure destinations in the surrounding master community.

overview: The building combines curved balconies and park-facing homes with its own leisure facilities. The brochure also describes the wider community’s water attractions and sports areas. Those shared destinations should be distinguished from facilities inside the ELO 2 building and checked for access conditions.
research.locationNote: DAMAC identifies ELO 2 within DAMAC Hills 2 in Dubailand. Its brochure maps access through Al Qudra Road and the wider road network. Confirm the selected building’s entrance and actual commute rather than treating advertised driving times as guarantees.
research.priceNote: Property Finder records an original AED 577,000 one-bedroom launch reference. This does not establish current available stock or a current developer quote. Ask for a dated unit offer with acquisition charges.
research.paymentNote: The reference stages below are Property Finder’s 20/50/30 structure. Tanami instead advertises 5% booking,55% construction and 40% handover on its main page. The difference remains unresolved; obtain the developer-issued schedule for the chosen unit.
research.handoverNote: Property Finder gives Q2 2027, while Tanami’s main page gives Q1 2028. No signed developer schedule was retrieved to resolve the difference; the headline date is deliberately unconfirmed.
